pma:database.name: overwatch_skins
pma:database.pma:table: CREATE TABLE `category` ( `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `icon_url` text CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci, `display_legacy_order` int DEFAULT NULL, `display_main_order` int DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `display_ow1` (`display_legacy_order`), KEY `display_ow2` (`display_main_order`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=20 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `hero` ( `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(30) NOT NULL, `role` enum('tank','damage','support') NOT NULL, `subrole` enum('initiator','bruiser','stalwart','specialist','recon','flanker','sharpshooter','tactician','medic','survivor') DEFAULT NULL, `release_date` date NOT NULL DEFAULT (curdate()), `portrait_url` text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`) ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=55 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `season` ( `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `start_date` date NOT NULL, `end_date` date NOT NULL, `id_chapter` int DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), KEY `id_chapter` (`id_chapter`), CONSTRAINT `season_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`id_chapter`) REFERENCES `chapter` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;

CREATE TABLE `skin` ( `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `id_hero` int NOT NULL, `id_category` int NOT NULL, `id_season` int DEFAULT NULL, `year` int DEFAULT NULL, `image_url` text NOT NULL, `rarity` enum('common','rare','epic','legendary','evolution','ultra','mythic') CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci DEFAULT NULL, `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL, `id_category_secondary` int DEFAULT NULL, `id_condition` int DEFAULT NULL, `recolor_of` int DEFAULT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`id`), UNIQUE KEY `id_hero_2` (`id_hero`,`name`), KEY `id_category` (`id_category`), KEY `id_season` (`id_season`), KEY `id_hero` (`id_hero`), KEY `id_category_secondary` (`id_category_secondary`), KEY `id_condition` (`id_condition`), KEY `recolor_of_skin` (`recolor_of`), CONSTRAINT `skin_category` FOREIGN KEY (`id_category`) REFERENCES `category` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `skin_category_secondary` FOREIGN KEY (`id_category_secondary`) REFERENCES `category` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `skin_condition` FOREIGN KEY (`id_condition`) REFERENCES `condition_special` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `skin_hero` FOREIGN KEY (`id_hero`) REFERENCES `hero` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `skin_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`recolor_of`) REFERENCES `skin` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT `skin_season` FOREIGN KEY (`id_season`) REFERENCES `season` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE ) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2170 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci;
